title: Selective detection of Cu2+ in aqueous medium using an acid hydrazide-based chemosensor: experimental and DFT/TDDFT studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4473-4485

Joardar Gim, Zannatul Kowser, Dipa Debnath, Redika Sarmin Prieety, Miss. Tasnim Jahan, Paul G. Waddell, Most Tahera Khatun, Sahara Khatun Munni, Md. Rashed Khan, Rashedul Islam
A Schiff base ligand, HP was developed for selective Cu²⁺ detection. HP was characterized by FTIR, NMR, HRMS, SCXRD, and elemental analysis. The Experimental results agreed with DFT/TD-DFT studies, with successful application in real water samples.
